snippet.title: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions - Enchanted Garden DLC - Release trailer
snippet.description:
Available Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4242210/Spirit_City_Lofi_Sessions__Enchanted_Garden_DLC

Step into nature and cultivate your green thumb with the Enchanted Garden DLC! This blossoming expansion opens the doors to a brand-new garden area.

Whether you’re tending to vibrant plants, decorating your greenhouse, or spending time with new nature-loving Spirits, this expansion adds a refreshing new way to relax, focus, and unwind. With soothing garden activities and plenty of whimsical customization options, you’ll have everything you need to create your own little sanctuary in Spirit City.

Join our cozy community!
